title: Endorsement Premium on the First Direct Bill Invoice — Installment Payment Plans Terms
content:
**Endorsement premium after a move off automatic draft.** When an Owner Auto Policy term's plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan at the named insured's request, the first invoice after the move bills endorsement premium left to bill as follows. The endorsement premium left to bill is every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the old schedule's installment premium for each of them. The installments left are the plan's number of installments less the installment invoices already issued, the first invoice's own installment included.

| Endorsement premium left to bill | Installments left | Added to the first invoice's premium |
|---|---|---|
| more than 100.00 | two or more | an equal share: that premium divided by the installments left, rounded half up to the cent |
| more than 100.00 | only one | all of it |
| above zero and at most 100.00 | any | all of it |
| zero or less | any | nothing |

*Hypothetical figures.* 270.00 left to bill with 3 installments left: 90.00 is added. 100.00 left with 3 installments left: the whole 100.00. 100.03 left with 3 left: 33.343… rounded to 33.34.

The records read are the Owner Auto Policy term's additional premium transactions and the plan's installment invoices.
